strings.home.description:
Mepee spreadsheet site na kọmputa gị wee gaa n'ihu na Google Sheets.

Mgbe ebubatara ma nyochaa ya, ngwa ahụ na-echekwa nnomi ndabere nke mbụ ma mepụta ụzọ mkpirisi n'ọnọdụ faịlụ ahụ.

Njikọ Google

Nzuzo njikọ Google
ZagoSheetsWin na-eji naanị ikike drive.file iji mepụta na jikwaa faịlụ eji ngwa ahụ. Ozi nbanye na-anọ na kọmputa a, Windows na-echekwa ya, a na-ezigakwa spreadsheets gị ozugbo na Google API - ha anaghị agafe sava Zagotools.

Ruo 20 MiB kwa faịlụ.

A na-ewere ọdịnaya dịka ederede nkịtị. Ọ bụrụ na enweghị ike inyocha ntụgharị ODS, a na-edobe nke mbụ. A na-echekwa nhọrọ ederede gị.
